spec:
In tools/fleet_gui.py:
1. In _build_tab_workers(), add 'elapsed' column to tree_workers:
   cols = ('id', 'name', 'provider', 'status', 'elapsed', 'credits_used', 'credits_rem', 'current_task', 'note')
   heading: 'Heartbeat'
   column width: 90, anchor 'center'
2. In _render_workers_table(), calculate elapsed time string from w.get('heartbeat_at') relative to current UTC time (e.g. '12s', '2m', '1h', or '-' if None). If w.get('heartbeat_at') is older than 120s or missing when status!='offline', use tag_cooldown or tag_offline.
3. In _build_tab_workers(), split into left treeview table and right inspector frame (self.worker_insp_frame) with width 320, displaying selected worker details: title, status, credits progress bar/text, heartbeat, current task id, and telemetry note on <<TreeviewSelect>> event.
Ensure all tests in tests/test_fleet_gui.py pass.
